name: notpeople-wave
description: Run an investor-outreach wave end to end: assemble the batch of targets, personalize pitches from real templates, send from the designated account, and log every touch in the CRM. Walks the exact checklist with rate limits and dedup against everyone already contacted. Triggers: "/notpeople-wave", "next outreach batch".
